## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused solution.

## Validation

List the commands and manual checks that passed. State anything that was not
run and why.

## Security and privacy

Describe any effect on encryption, authentication, browser permissions,
cross-context messaging, stored data, network requests, or public claims. Write
`No security or privacy impact` when none applies.

## Screenshots

Include before and after screenshots for visible UI changes, or write
`Not applicable`.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated work.
- [ ] Tests cover the behavior and meaningful failure paths.
- [ ] Required tests, lint, builds, and audits passed.
- [ ] No secrets, customer data, generated files, or build output are included.
- [ ] Security, privacy, accessibility, performance, and compatibility were
      reviewed where relevant.
- [ ] Documentation and public claims match the implementation.
- [ ] Version fields and changelogs are updated when required.
- [ ] The pull-request title follows the commit convention.
